documents.title: North Office Maintenance Policy
documents.text: Meridian North office maintenance requests must be submitted through the North service portal. Urgent water leaks must be reported to the North facilities desk immediately. Routine maintenance requests have a target acknowledgement time of two business days.

documents.title: South Retail Maintenance Policy
documents.text: Meridian South retail maintenance requests must be submitted through the South tenant portal. Urgent water leaks must be reported to the South duty manager immediately. Routine maintenance requests have a target acknowledgement time of one business day.
